description: On the bed in front of you there’s a pink bowl, a couple of dice and domino tiles, a yellow puzzle-piece shape, a small purple block, and a rectangular wooden piece. The left hand stays mostly resting near the dominoes, while the right hand reaches to the purple block on the right, grips it as a right-hand object, lifts it, moves leftward over the bowl, and drops it into the bowl before withdrawing.
